description: This source file defines utility functions for file system operations such as writing a file if its contents have changed, and removing files or directories if they exist.

methods.name: writeTextFileIfChanged
methods.description: Writes the specified content to a file only if the content differs from the current file contents; creates directories as needed.

methods.name: removeFileIfExists
methods.description: Removes the specified file if it exists, returning true if the operation succeeded.

methods.name: removePathIfExists
methods.description: Removes the specified directory or file path recursively if it exists, returning true if successful.
